description: This file contains helper functions for interacting with the BLS (Bureau of Labor Statistics) API, including fetching timeseries data, accessing static assets, and updating static assets related to survey categories.

methods.name: get_bls_timeseries
methods.description: Fetches BLS timeseries data with constraints on symbols and historical window.

methods.name: get_survey_asset
methods.description: Retrieves survey asset data from the BLS FTP download folder.

methods.name: download_category_series_ids
methods.description: Downloads all series IDs and code maps for a specified survey category.

methods.name: open_asset
methods.description: Opens a static asset file (JSON or compressed CSV) for series IDs or code maps.

methods.name: update_static_asset
methods.description: Updates static asset files with series IDs and code maps for a given category.
